title: Gateway: a server section names an instance and can drop the built-in tools
body:
One gateway binary can now front a different set of upstreams under its own name. A second instance (the org-status MCP `scientific-research-news`) can then reuse the OAuth server instead of copying `oauth.py`.

- **New optional `server` section** in the gateway config: `name`, `instructions`, and `builtin_tools`. With `builtin_tools: false` the instance drops `web__search` and the `rag__*` tools, so it lists only `gateway_status` and its upstreams.
- **Omitting the section keeps today's behaviour exactly.**
- **Tests:** one new test in `tests/test_gateway.py`; 9/9 pass. Ruff is clean. Documented in `docs/mcp-clients.md`.

title: Bring over CLAUDE.md, HARVEST.md and INTEGRATION.md from the monorepo
body:
## Summary

Brings over the three docs from the audio-projects monorepo's `tools/paper-library` (package `paperlib`), which is being replaced by this repo (polarizetech/audio-projects#26). dataset-fetch keeps the same three files at its root:

- `CLAUDE.md`: measured facts, gotchas and design decisions, with their dates.
- `HARVEST.md`: the procedure for bulk-collecting a topic into the library.
- `INTEGRATION.md`: how a consumer depends on paper-fetch. It covers the install from git with a pinned commit, setting up the S3/Spaces store through `PAPER_FETCH_*` in `~/.config/paper-fetch/*.env`, the Python API and the MCP server.

Names, commands, env vars and APIs are rewritten to paper-fetch's own and checked against `src/paper_fetch/`. Behaviour that has changed since the monorepo copy is described as it is now:

- **Catalogue writes:** since `bee1bfe` a save merges this process's changes instead of the last writer winning.
- **Cache:** it lives under `PAPER_FETCH_CACHE` and applies only to the S3 store.
- **`load_env()`:** `Library.default()` does not call it, so Python consumers must.

Monorepo-only material is dropped: the `tools/.venv-sci` commands, `sync.py` and the generated copy, mcpkit envelopes, and REGISTRY/ORG-PROTOCOL references. Live measurements from the monorepo copy are kept, dated and labelled as such.

Docs only; no code changes.

## Test plan

- [x] Every command, flag and env var named in the docs exists in `src/paper_fetch/`.
- [x] `uv run pytest` passes (214 tests).

title: feat: landing layer and cell field
body:
A lab's front door, in both renderers, drawn from the polarize.tech homepage redesign.

## What's added
- **`landing.css`** (zero-build) and **`src/components/landing.tsx`** (React), rendering the same classes: `TopNav`, `Hero`, `Cta`, `Section`, `ProcessSteps`, `Promises`, `ProjectFeature`, `RepoCard`, `ChangeFeed`, `FeaturedArticle`, `ArticleCard`, `MetaLine`, `StoryCard` / `StoryRow` / `StoryGrid`, `Plate`, `Principle`, `TierLegend`, `SiteFooter`. Responsive to phone width; the top bar folds into a `<details>` menu with no script.
- **`cellfield.js`**: `<ui-cellfield>`, a WebGL speck field (clusters at different depths, per-cell polarisation, occasional coordinated waves, an optional hero cell). Decoration only: `aria-hidden`, no fetch, one still frame under `prefers-reduced-motion`. React: `<CellField>`, same engine, typed by `cellfield.d.ts`.
- **Token:** `radius.xs` (4px).
- **Checks:** `dev_check.py` holds `landing.css` to the publication.css rules (generalised as `check_layer`) and checks `cellfield.js`; `scripts/api_surface.py` lists both files.
- **Storybook:** *General UI/Landing*: the full homepage at desktop and phone, plus each part.

## Versioning
Additive only: nothing renamed or removed (`api_surface.py --removed v0.5.5` is empty), so this is a patch release.

## Checks
- `python3 dev_check.py`: 309/309
- `build_css.py --check`, `build_shadcn.py --check`: up to date
- `tsc -p .`: clean

title: E01-stentor-map: Stentor-mapped habituation constraints (SR1–SR3) on the depression cascade
body:
Preregistered experiment. See experiments/E01-stentor-map/PREREG.md and RESULTS.md.

**Closed: FAIL** (`E01-stentor-map-closed`, f10f688). 90 runs, 0 failed, model-v0.1.0.

| | pre-registered (efficacy) | observed (spikes) | verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| SR1-std: decrement deepens as recovery slows | 0.126 → 0.494 → 0.624 → 0.728 | 0.057 → 0.418 → 0.597 → 0.765 | **PASS** |
| SR1-std: half-point later | 4 → 6 → 6 → 7 | 4 → 5.5 → 8 → 8 | **PASS** |
| SR1-hebb_only: predicted null | no change | D16 unchanged (≤ ±0.023); median half point 4 → 4.5 | **FAIL** (half-point clause) |
| SR3-std: strong insert deepens | −0.21 % / −0.33 % | −0.69 % / −0.93 %, under MDE 3.5 % | **UNINTERPRETABLE** (analyse.py: FAIL) |
| SR3-hebb_only | deepening | −0.74 % (under MDE) / **−3.46 % [−5.92, −1.00]** | **UNINTERPRETABLE** (analyse.py: FAIL) |
| SR2: decrement–rate slope | +28.7 / +19.8 dB/decade | slow-rate decrement below the ±0.03 floor | not computable |

- **Stentor's longer retention after a block:** not reproduced by the depression cascade (0 at ×1 and ×0.25; control at the floor at ×0.1 and frozen). It appears only in `hebb_only`, on shrinking n.
- No dishabituation in any arm.
- Deviations #1–#4 are in DEVIATIONS.md; #4 was decided with the outcome known.
- Exploratory (fast-forward vs direct gaps) is under `exploratory/`.
- Next EID: RESULTS.md §8.
- Merge with a merge commit, never a squash.
